name: Hierarchical Iso-Surface Extraction
definition: An algorithm that uses a k-d tree to adaptively subdivide the domain and identify active cells containing the iso-surface, querying the INR only at active cell corners to reduce computation.
summary: Hierarchical Iso-Surface Extraction is an adaptive algorithm that uses k-d tree traversal and uncertainty propagation to efficiently identify active cells for isosurface extraction from implicit neural representations.
